# The Weather Net

> > The Weather Net delivers hyperlocal 14-day forecasts for 200,000+ cities worldwide with real-time conditions, regional weather maps, and climate science insights.

The Weather Net (powered by Meteored Canada) provides comprehensive weather forecasting across Canada and globally, combining detailed meteorological data with travel guides and climate news. The platform serves users seeking multi-day forecasts, provincial weather updates, and weather-related travel information.

## Key Topics

- 14-day forecast
- weather forecast
- Canada weather
- daily forecast
- provincial weather

## Global & Regional Forecasts

- [Weather Forecast 14 days - Meteored Canada](https://www.theweather.net): Homepage offering 14-day forecasts for 200k+ cities worldwide
- [The weather around the world - Meteored Canada](https://www.theweather.net/world.htm): Global weather forecasts by region with current conditions

## Canadian Provincial Weather

- [Weather for the Province of Alberta. 14-day forecast - Meteored Canada](https://www.theweather.net/alberta-county.htm): 14-day weather forecast and maps for Alberta province
- [Weather British Columbia. 14-day forecast - Meteored Canada](https://www.theweather.net/british-columbia-county.htm): 14-day weather forecast and maps for British Columbia
- [Weather Manitoba. 14-day forecast - Meteored Canada](https://www.theweather.net/manitoba-county.htm): 14-day weather forecast and maps for Manitoba province
- [Weather for the Province of New Brunswick. 14-day forecast - Meteored Canada](https://www.theweather.net/new-brunswick-county.htm): 14-day weather forecast and maps for New Brunswick province
- [Weather Newfoundland. 14-day forecast - Meteored Canada](https://www.theweather.net/newfoundland-county.htm): 14-day weather forecast and maps for Newfoundland province

## Travel & Leisure Weather

- [This California Desert Is the Hottest Place in the World: Tips for Visiting Death Valley](https://www.theweather.net/news/leisure/this-california-desert-is-the-hottest-place-in-the-world-tips-for-visiting-death-valley.html): Travel guide to Death Valley with visiting tips and extreme heat facts
- [The global impact of the Middle East airspace closure you need to know before travelling](https://www.theweather.net/news/leisure/the-global-impact-of-the-middle-east-airspace-closure-you-need-to-know-before-travelling.html): Analysis of Middle East airspace closure effects on flights and routes

## Climate & Science News

- [A study on microbes supports the idea that life could have travelled between planets under extreme conditions](https://www.theweather.net/news/trending/a-study-on-microbes-supports-the-idea-that-life-could-have-travelled-between-planets-under-extreme-conditions.html): Johns Hopkins study on extremophile bacteria and interplanetary life
- [Good news! Antarctic sea ice has melted slightly less this year](https://www.theweather.net/news/trending/good-news-antarctic-sea-ice-has-melted-slightly-less-this-year.html): Climate news on Antarctic sea ice extent from NSIDC data
